baseline.dataset: 28 synthetic fixture batches serialized in both validation artifacts

contract.effective_work_unit: image represented as a flat list
contract.precision_policy: Python float arithmetic; finite small numeric CPU fixtures
allowed_changes: Replace batch statistics with per-image statistics
Return [] for empty batch; raise ValueError for empty image
contract.sampling_and_augmentation: Deterministic normalization only; no stochastic transform present

measurement.window: One bounded CPU correctness run per implementation; 28 fixture batches and 7 checks
measurement.job_boundary: normalize(images) only; no training or performance timing

evidence: Source pooled all batch pixels for mean and variance
hypothesis.change: Compute statistics within the per-image loop
hypothesis.predicted_effect: Remove dependence on unrelated batch images

limitations: 仅验证 CPU 确定性统计行为；这不能建立随机增强参数、抽样粒度或随机流等价性。
未验证 GPU、生产训练、下游损失/梯度/优化器更新或任务质量。
未进行吞吐量、延迟或内存基准；不声称性能加速。
